title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 23: the two sisters Oholah and Oholibah, the nations they turned to, and the judgment announced on Samaria and Jerusalem.

questions.text: What were the names of the two women, the daughters of one mother?
questions.explanation: The chapter says there were two women, daughters of one mother, and that their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister.

questions.text: Which city does the chapter say the name Oholibah stands for?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says that Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.

questions.text: On which neighbouring people did Oholah set her heart, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The chapter says Oholah doted on her lovers, the Assyrians her neighbors, who were clothed with blue and were governors and rulers.

questions.text: What does the chapter say Oholah became among women after judgment was executed on her?
questions.explanation: After she was delivered into the hand of the Assyrians, they killed her with the sword and she became a byword among women.

questions.text: What did Oholibah see portrayed on the wall?
questions.explanation: The chapter says she saw men portrayed on the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with red.

questions.text: Where did Oholibah send her messengers?
questions.explanation: As soon as she saw them she sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

questions.text: Besides the Babylonians, the Chaldeans and the Assyrians, which three groups are named as coming against Oholibah?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh says he will bring the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, and all the Assyrians against her.

questions.text: Whose cup is Oholibah told she will drink?
questions.explanation: Because she walked in the way of her sister, her sister's cup is given into her hand: the cup of her sister Samaria.

answers.text: The cup of her neighbour Egypt
The cup of her sister Samaria
The cup of the king of Babylon
The cup of all the nations

questions.text: What two things does the chapter say the sisters did to the things of the Lord in the same day?
questions.explanation: The chapter says they defiled his sanctuary in the same day and profaned his Sabbaths.

answers.text: They defiled his sanctuary and profaned his Sabbaths
They burned his altar and stole his incense
They tore the curtain and shut the gate
They sold his oil and his wine

questions.text: Who, according to this chapter, will judge the two sisters?
questions.explanation: Verse 45 says righteous men will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and of women who shed blood.
